request.style: English, solo female voice, warm and reverent, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, light percussion, hopeful and joyful, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Sing to the LORD a new song
He has done great wonders today
His right hand and holy arm
Have won him victory in light

[Pre-Chorus]
The LORD has made his salvation known
Revealed his righteousness clear
Before the eyes of all nations
His truth is now appearing here

[Chorus]
Sing to the LORD a new song
Shout for joy to all the earth
All the ends have seen the light
Salvation of our God is worth

[Verse]
He has remembered his mercy
His faithfulness to Israel
The whole world has seen the way
His love is fully revealed

[Pre-Chorus]
The LORD has made his salvation known
Revealed his righteousness clear
Before the eyes of all nations
His truth is now appearing here

[Chorus]
Sing to the LORD a new song
Shout for joy to all the earth
All the ends have seen the light
Salvation of our God is worth

[Bridge]
Make music to the LORD with lyre
With the sound of sweet song
With trumpets and ram's horn shout
Before the King, the Lord

[Outro]
Sing to the LORD a new song
His victory is forever strong
